title: 'the true founding record' (obtained at Highward's record-house, read aloud at the moor's oath-stone) and the separately-quested 'Founding Ledger' (Marrowgate's Hall of Ledgers, gated behind 'Penn, the Church, gold, or your own hands') are similarly named and thematically identical; the game never clarifies whether the former can substitute for the throne's 'read the founding ledger aloud' ending, and I ran out of turns before reaching the Hall of Ledgers to check.
